versions.name: King James Version
versions.about: The classic English Bible, the one this app has always used.

versions.name: World English Bible
versions.about: Modern, easy-to-read English. Uses “Yahweh” for God’s name.

versions.name: Bible in Basic English
versions.about: Written with only about 1,000 everyday words, so it is very easy to follow.

versions.name: American Standard Version
versions.about: A careful word-for-word revision of the KJV. Uses “Jehovah” for God’s name.

versions.name: Young’s Literal Translation
versions.about: Extremely literal: keeps the original word order and tenses. Good for study.
